features.name: Spellcasting
features.summary: Full Wisdom caster that prepares spells daily from the whole cleric list (Wis mod + cleric level, min 1). Can ritual-cast prepared ritual spells; holy symbol works as focus.

features.name: Divine Domain
features.summary: Pick a domain tied to your deity (Knowledge, Life, Light, Nature, Tempest, Trickery, War). It grants features at 1st, 2nd (Channel Divinity option), 6th, 8th and 17th level.

features.name: Domain Spells
features.summary: Your domain adds two spells at cleric levels 1, 3, 5, 7 and 9. They are always prepared, don't count toward your prepared total, and count as cleric spells for you.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.summary: Spend a use to create one divine effect: Turn Undead or your domain's option(s). Save DCs use your cleric spell save DC. Uses return on a short or long rest; 2 uses at 6th, 3 at 18th.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Turn Undead
features.summary: Action: undead within 30 ft. that see or hear you make a Wis save; on a failure each is turned for 1 minute or until damaged, fleeing you and unable to take reactions.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.summary: At 4th, 8th, 12th, 16th and 19th level, add +2 to one ability or +1 to two abilities (max 20).

features.name: Destroy Undead
features.summary: Undead that fail the save against your Turn Undead are destroyed outright if their CR is at or below the threshold: 1/2 at 5th, 1 at 8th, 2 at 11th, 3 at 14th, 4 at 17th.

features.name: Divine Intervention
features.summary: Action: ask your god for help and roll d100; if the roll is no higher than your cleric level the DM grants aid. Success locks it for 7 days, failure until a long rest. Auto-succeeds at 20th.

features.name: Blessings of Knowledge
features.summary: Learn two languages and gain proficiency in two of Arcana, History, Nature or Religion; your proficiency bonus is doubled for checks with those two skills.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Knowledge of the Ages
features.summary: Action: choose one skill or tool and be proficient with it for 10 minutes.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Read Thoughts
features.summary: Action: a creature within 60 ft. makes a Wis save. On a failure you read its surface thoughts for 1 minute and may end it to cast suggestion on it (no slot, auto-fail). If it saves, you can't retry this until a long rest.

features.name: Potent Spellcasting
features.summary: Add your Wisdom modifier to damage dealt by your cleric cantrips.

features.name: Visions of the Past
features.summary: Meditate (concentration, up to Wis-score minutes) to see past events: Object Reading reveals an item's previous owner(s); Area Reading reveals significant events nearby going back Wis-score days.

choices.name: Object Reading
choices.summary: After 1 minute holding an object, learn how its owner got and lost it and the latest notable event involving them; extra minutes reveal earlier recent owners.

choices.name: Area Reading
choices.summary: Each minute of meditation reveals one significant event in the surrounding area (up to a 50-ft. cube), newest first, going back up to Wis-score days.

features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.summary: Gain heavy armor proficiency.

features.name: Disciple of Life
features.summary: Healing spells of 1st level or higher restore an extra 2 + spell level hit points to each creature they heal.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Preserve Life
features.summary: Action: split 5 x cleric level hit points of healing among creatures within 30 ft., raising none above half its max HP. No effect on undead or constructs.

features.name: Blessed Healer
features.summary: When a 1st-level-or-higher spell of yours heals someone other than you, you also regain 2 + spell level hit points.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.summary: Once per turn on a weapon hit, add 1d8 radiant damage (2d8 from 14th level).

features.name: Supreme Healing
features.summary: Healing spell dice are not rolled; each die counts as its maximum value.

features.name: Bonus Cantrip
features.summary: Learn the light cantrip if you don't already know it.

features.name: Warding Flare
features.summary: Reaction when a creature within 30 ft. you can see attacks you: impose disadvantage on that attack (creatures immune to blindness are unaffected).

features.name: Channel Divinity: Radiance of the Dawn
features.summary: Action: dispel magical darkness within 30 ft.; hostile creatures there make a Con save, taking 2d10 + cleric level radiant damage (half on success). Total cover protects.

features.name: Improved Flare
features.summary: Warding Flare can also protect another creature attacked within 30 ft. of you.

features.name: Potent Spellcasting
features.summary: Add your Wisdom modifier to damage dealt by your cleric cantrips.

features.name: Corona of Light
features.summary: Action: emit sunlight (60 ft. bright, 30 ft. more dim) for 1 minute; enemies in the bright light have disadvantage on saves against fire or radiant spells.

features.name: Acolyte of Nature
features.summary: Learn one druid cantrip and gain proficiency in Animal Handling, Nature or Survival (pick one).

features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.summary: Gain heavy armor proficiency.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Charm Animals and Plants
features.summary: Action: beasts and plant creatures within 30 ft. that see you make a Wis save or are charmed (friendly to you and allies) for 1 minute or until damaged.

features.name: Dampen Elements
features.summary: Reaction: give yourself or a creature within 30 ft. resistance against one instance of acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder damage.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.summary: Once per turn on a weapon hit, add 1d8 cold, fire or lightning damage (your pick); 2d8 from 14th level.

features.name: Master of Nature
features.summary: Bonus action: command creatures charmed by your Charm Animals and Plants what to do on their next turn.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.summary: Gain martial weapon and heavy armor proficiency.

features.name: Wrath of the Storm
features.summary: Reaction when a creature within 5 ft. that you can see hits you: it makes a Dex save, taking 2d8 lightning or thunder damage (half on success).

features.name: Channel Divinity: Destructive Wrath
features.summary: When you roll lightning or thunder damage, spend Channel Divinity to deal the maximum instead of rolling.

features.name: Thunderbolt Strike
features.summary: When you deal lightning damage to a Large or smaller creature, you can also push it up to 10 ft. away.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.summary: Once per turn on a weapon hit, add 1d8 thunder damage (2d8 from 14th level).

features.name: Stormborn
features.summary: Gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed while not underground or indoors.

features.name: Blessing of the Trickster
features.summary: Action: touch a willing creature other than you to give it advantage on Dex (Stealth) checks for 1 hour or until you use this again.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Invoke Duplicity
features.summary: Action: create an illusory double within 30 ft. for 1 minute (concentration). Bonus action moves it 30 ft. (stay within 120 ft.); you may cast spells from its space and gain advantage on attacks vs. creatures adjacent to both of you.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Cloak of Shadows
features.summary: Action: become invisible until the end of your next turn; attacking or casting a spell ends it.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.summary: Once per turn on a weapon hit, add 1d8 poison damage (2d8 from 14th level).

features.name: Improved Duplicity
features.summary: Invoke Duplicity creates up to four duplicates; one bonus action moves any of them up to 30 ft. each (within 120 ft.).

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.summary: Gain martial weapon and heavy armor proficiency.

features.name: War Priest
features.summary: When you take the Attack action, you can make one extra weapon attack as a bonus action.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Guided Strike
features.summary: After seeing your attack roll but before the result is declared, spend Channel Divinity for +10 to that roll.

features.name: Channel Divinity: War God's Blessing
features.summary: Reaction: spend Channel Divinity to give +10 to an attack roll made by a creature within 30 ft. (decide after the roll, before the result).

features.name: Divine Strike
features.summary: Once per turn on a weapon hit, add 1d8 damage of the weapon's damage type (2d8 from 14th level).

features.name: Avatar of Battle
features.summary: Gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons.

discrepancies: Subclasses: 6 of the 7 PHB domains (Knowledge, Light, Nature, Tempest, Trickery, War) exist in the app with an EMPTY features array - every domain feature listed in this audit is missing for them (Knowledge 5, Light 6, Nature 6, Tempest 6, Trickery 5, War 6 features).
Domain spells: no subclass in the app (including Life) has a domain spell list; the PHB gives each domain 10 always-prepared spells at cleric levels 1/3/5/7/9 (see `spells` on each subclass here).

Supreme Healing (Life Domain, 17th level) is wrongly listed in the generic cleric `features` array at level 17, so every cleric would get it; it is also missing from the Life subclass's own features (app Life stops at Divine Strike 8).

Limited-use resources are not modeled anywhere in the app data: Channel Divinity (1 use at 2nd, 2 at 6th, 3 at 18th, short rest), Divine Intervention (1/long rest, 7-day lockout on success), Warding Flare / Wrath of the Storm / War Priest (Wis mod, min 1, per long rest), Visions of the Past (1/short rest). The progression `special.channel_divinity_charges` exists but no recharge info.

Feature naming differs from the book: app uses 'Spellcasting: Cleric' (book: 'Spellcasting'), 'Destroy Undead (CR 1/2 or below)' etc. (book table: 'Destroy Undead (CR 1/2)'), 'Divine Intervention Improvement' (book: 'Divine Intervention improvement', which is part of Divine Intervention, not a separate feature). 'Channel Divinity' appears as three separate features '(1/rest)', '(2/rest)', '(3/rest)' instead of one feature with scaling uses.

Progression rows list 'Domain Spells' at levels 1, 3, 5, 7 and 9 and 'Channel Divinity: Turn Undead' at 2; the book's class table does not list these (they are sub-features of Divine Domain / Channel Divinity) - harmless but not book-accurate.
Life Domain 'Divine Strike' in the app is a single level-8 entry; the 14th-level increase to 2d8 is only in the text (same for all domains) - fine, but no level-14 marker exists for any domain.

Verified matching the book: hit die d8, saves Wis/Cha, armor (light, medium, shields), simple weapons, no tools, skill list (History, Insight, Medicine, Persuasion, Religion; choose 2), spellcasting ability Wis, subclassLevel 1, proficiency bonus, cantrips known (3/4/5 at 1/4/10) and all spell slot counts for levels 1-20, Destroy Undead CR thresholds (1/2, 1, 2, 3, 4 at 5/8/11/14/17).
